note: The musics a video can play in the background. `start`: where a track is in full swing (seconds), `lufs`: its loudness as recorded; both measured (scripts/make-musics.py). `about` is what the AI reads to choose one.

tracks.name: Drift Phonk
tracks.author: sub_clair
tracks.about: Drift phonk, about 117 BPM: heavy bass, aggressive, driving. For kills, action, clutch plays, anything that shows skill.

tracks.name: Drift Phonk II
tracks.author: sub_clair
tracks.about: Drift phonk, slower (about 96 BPM) and very bass-heavy: menacing, confident. For domination, kill streaks, a slow build of tension before action.

tracks.name: Night Drift
tracks.author: zephiramusic
tracks.about: Drift phonk, fast (about 136 BPM), dark, with breaks between its heavy parts. For chases, intense fights, or a tense video that explodes now and then.

tracks.name: Energetic Hip-Hop
tracks.author: skilsel
tracks.about: Energetic hip-hop beat, punchy and confident. For best-ofs, highlights, banter, a video that should feel like a show.

tracks.name: Stream Starting
tracks.author: the_mountain
tracks.about: A 'stream starting' theme, mid-tempo, that builds up. For best-ofs of an evening, recaps, a video that presents the channel.

tracks.name: Vlog Intro
tracks.author: kulakovka
tracks.about: Upbeat, sunny vlog music. For light, good-humoured videos: funny moments between friends, wholesome or silly scenes.

tracks.name: Arcade Retro Nights
tracks.author: alex-morgan
tracks.about: Synthwave, about 123 BPM: retro arcade, neon, driving. For racing, night scenes, stylish plays, anything with an 80s feel.

tracks.name: Pixel Chiptune
tracks.author: alex-morgan
tracks.about: Fast chiptune (about 144 BPM), like an old console game: playful, frantic. For fails, chaos, absurd or silly moments.

tracks.name: Pixel Art Soundtrack
tracks.author: echoes_of_lumen
tracks.about: Chiptune at a walking pace (about 112 BPM): cute, light-hearted, a little nostalgic. For gentle humour and cosy game moments.

tracks.name: 8-Bit Retro
tracks.author: the_mountain
tracks.about: Very fast 8-bit tune (about 161 BPM): cartoonish, hectic. For slapstick, fails in a row, a sped-up feeling.

tracks.name: Lofi Upbeat
tracks.author: jonasblakewood
tracks.about: Upbeat lofi (about 108 BPM): relaxed but bright. For conversations, stories told on stream, calm role-play scenes.

tracks.name: Lofi Upbeat II
tracks.author: kulakovka
tracks.about: Laid-back lofi (about 92 BPM): warm, unhurried. For long talks, chill moments, a video that is mostly people speaking.

tracks.name: Chill Lo-Fi
tracks.author: zephiramusic
tracks.about: Muffled, mellow lo-fi with little treble: stays in the background. For serious or quiet discussions, late-night moods, low-key tension.
